showcase.title: U14 80/100 FPS Scope Showcase
showcase.playerPerspective: Use FPS Budget. The diagnostics tool must show FPS scope, Raylib benchmark status, loaded-data flag, and timing threshold evidence without overclaiming.
showcase.modAuthorPerspective: Treat FPS as a scoped renderer and data-load claim; inspect p95/p99, overlay scope, and production thresholds before calling it ready.
